newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF raises some prices by about 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: BASF raises some prices by about 7 pct.

text.p: German chemicals company BASF AG said on Monday it was raising its prices for dispersions, resins and additives by around seven percent from August 1.
BASF said increased personnel, environmental and service costs were behind the price increase. Prices for these products have generally fallen in recent years, it said.
The products are used in the paints, coatings and adhesive industries, for textile and protective coatings and for the production of non-wovens.
The company, which is already a leading European supplier of polymer dispersions, said it planned to invest around 100 million marks per year in research and development in this area.
